name: Rong bien
summary: Seaweed from the Bãi Xếp fishing village. A 4 Feb 2021 article on Cổng du lịch Quy Nhơn – Bình Định says residents dry it for a cool summer drink and also cook it with chè.
origin: Bãi Xếp, 13 km south of the center on quốc lộ 1D, the Quy Nhơn–Sông Cầu road.
howToEat: Drink it in summer, or eat it in the sweet soup. The article says residents described that use.
A stall hour was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Bãi Xếp. The article credits vnexpress.net at the end and runs on the tourism portal.
